mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have a temperature of 61 degrees with slight rain currently reported near the Verona Area High School. We are also seeing a first quarter moon phase tonight.

The city has announced that chip seal road maintenance will begin on September 23, affecting Cross Country Road, parts of East Verona Avenue, and the Liberty Business Park, so please plan your travels accordingly. Additionally, the Plan Commission is meeting on October 5 to review several development projects including work at 201 South Main Street and at the Sub-Zero facility.

There is a lot to do in our community, starting today with the Sugar River Fire and Smoke BBQ Festival and the Dane County Farmer's Market. Tomorrow, you can participate in the Bike the Barns fundraiser at Badger Prairie County Park.

Looking at the most recent activity, on September 5, officers responded to reports of cheese being placed on vehicle windshields, which was identified as a social media prank, and luckily no damage was found.
The Culver's of Verona location is currently undergoing a remodel, but they will be ready to serve you when they open today at 10 AM with today's flavor of the day.
